name: Inklink.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
Inklink.io is a free drawing game. Have you ever wanted to draw stick figures competitively with friends or enemies from around the globe? Well, Inklink.io knows what you dream and has delivered you exactly what you want! Inklink.io is a game where you can draw with your friends. This is a real-time game where the other players scan see what you're drawing and make guesses as you go.  Whenever you guess correctly it becomes your turn to draw, the game is that simple and that fun. Challenge your friends or impress the legions of strangers who haunt internet game forums. With the number of users out there you'll never find yourself without a worthy opponenet. We think that you will love Inklink.io, it's charades for the creatively inclined. Can you guess the subject of the sketch before everybody else in the room? Then, when it's your turn to draw, use your mouse to sketch an image. This new and improved version of InkLink features:

  • More word subjects
  • Redesigned lobby makes it easier to find a game
  • More game rooms
  • No mid-game advertisements

Feeling sketchy? Play today!
NOTE: InkLink is an unsupervised multiplayer game.
We cannot monitor user-created content that might overstep the bounds of good taste!
